pr_body:
# Pull Request

## Related issue
Fixes #3006

## What does this PR do?
- fixes the display function of `ParseError::ReservedGeo`.  The previous display string was missing back ticks around available filters.
- makes  the filter-parser parse `_geo(x,y,z)` and `geoDistance(x,y,z)` filters. Both parsing functions will throw an error if the filter was used.
- removes `FilterError::ReservedGeo` and `FilterError::Reserved` error variants since they are now thrown by the filter-parser.

I ran `cargo test --package milli -- --test-threads 1` and the tests passed.

## PR checklist
Please check if your PR fulfills the following requirements:
- [x] Does this PR fix an existing issue, or have you listed the changes applied in the PR description (and why they are needed)?
- [x] Have you read the contributing guidelines?
- [ ] Have you made sure that the title is accurate and descriptive of the changes?

Thank you so much for contributing to Meilisearch!

issue_context.title: Bad latitude / Bad longitude should share a common message between the invalid sort and invalid filter
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**

- `filter`: `Bad latitude `1000`. Latitude must be contained between -90 and 90 degrees.`
- `sort`: `Latitude must be contained between -90 and 90 degrees.`

We should throw the same error in both case (the one from the filter) => Fixed by #3479

This changes should be done in milli folder.

More information about the expectations
- [ ] If I try to filter on `_geo(x, y, z)` we should trigger the special reserved keywords error 
- [ ] If I try to filter on `_geoDistance(x, y, z)` we should trigger the special reserved keywords error 
- [x] If I try to sort on `_geoRadius(x, y)` we should trigger the special reserved keywords error. Fixed by #3479
- [x] If I try to sort on `_geo(x, y)` we should trigger the special reserved keywords error. Fixed by https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/pull/3631
- [x] If I try to sort on `_geoDistance(x, y)` we should trigger the special reserved keywords error. Fixed by https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/pull/3631
